summary: 'Rhythms of Nature' develops observation, evidence, everyday application and connected understanding through 'Rhythms of Nature'. The main learning is organised around the source-supported points below.
key_points: They also know about the Sun, moon, stars and wonders of the world they live in.
This unit invites students to explore the deep connection between nature and everyday life.
This unit in Grade 5, helps students explore the natural rhythms and deep connections that shape the life on Earth.
Through seasons, stories and journeys of birds, foods and ideas, they discover how nature, people and cultures are linked.
With journaling and hands-on activities, they connect to their surroundings and understand that Earth is our shared, living home.
